page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached volumes. It offers a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The absence of bundled local storage and GPU hardware reduces resource overhead, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require hardware acceleration or high-speed local disk access.

Given its balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio and dedicated compute resources, the ecs.u2i-c1m4.6xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads. Suitable applications include standard web serving, application servers, enterprise office applications, and medium-sized databases that rely on network-attached storage.
